comment.body: Thanks for the detailed OmniTray proposal and prototype material. This is currently assigned for maintainer evaluation as a potential new PowerToy. Because the proposal spans persistent stacks, drag surfaces, commands, shell integration, and out-of-process extensions, this issue should remain the product/design discussion until maintainers select an initial supported scope; implementation trackers can then be split from that accepted scope.

judgment.rationale: The proposal already has explicit maintainer ownership, so independent dashboard design work would duplicate the active upstream evaluation.
evidence: The issue is labeled Idea-New PowerToy.
The issue is assigned to PowerToys maintainer jiripolasek.
